description: This file is a content script for a web extension, handling message passing and clipping actions such as screenshot, page clipping, and article clipping within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: attachMessagePort
methods.description: Sets up a message listener for clipping and viewport requests, attaching event handlers to process messages and invoke clipping functions.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Performs clipping actions based on message parameters, such as taking screenshots, clipping pages, or articles.
